summary: Enhance your understanding of landlord-tenant law with our comprehensive training course. Gain essential skills to navigate legal challenges effectively.
lede: Landlord-tenant law sets out rights and responsibilities that shape rental relationships. This course is for property managers and other professionals who handle rental housing, helping them assess leases, manage rent and deposits, coordinate repairs, and respond to tenant complaints. It also covers tenant protections, dispute resolution, ending tenancies, and documenting decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly deal with rental properties, tenants, and landlord-tenant issues.
audience: Corporate real estate and facilities managers
Compliance and risk officers in property
modules: Landlord-Tenant Law in Public and NGO Housing Contexts
Risk Management, Documentation, and Policy Improvement
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of property management or housing administration. Familiarity with legal terminology is beneficial but not required.
